answer: Quiet clones go broke by decay. A joiner parks 2,500 POA in a yield-free velvet reserve and posts one work receipt to open. Each epoch the key must raise a lantern, a fresh work hash in 25 minutes, or 160 POA is burned. If left to wander idle, four burns seize the rest and exile the key 20 epochs. One honest lock is 2,500 POA; 1,000 idle copies need 2.5 million POA and bleed 160,000 POA each quiet epoch, vs a ~200 POA payout. Risk: a farm flashes one cheap task then sleeps. Fix: after any gap the next lantern needs a unique challenge nonce, and co-funded keys decay together.
